reply_text:
I've replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api. The depot was Southgate.

The source is that channel's history, which Tobias can see because he's a member. On 2025-09-03, Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Later that day she said Southgate had cleared the backlog. Nobody in the channel gave a street address for Southgate, and there are no Tansley account files in the share, so I suggested he ask Priyanka if he needs the full address.

I couldn't check gbrain first because it refused the search. Its access token isn't tied to any member, and nothing was read. To fix it, someone on the brain host would need to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`, or set it up for a shared agent with `--may-act-for`. The answer didn't depend on gbrain.
